notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Week 2
notes.content:
[p]Thanks to everyone who has continued to play and provide feedback. 

This week's patches were a bit smaller as I have shifted my focus to preparing some new content for Next Fest. There will be a balance patch next week to boost up some the protocols that might feel underwhelming and of course I'll continue to address bugs and issues as they arise.

V 0.8.1.18 [/p][list][*][p]Continued fiddling with enemy attack visuals,[/p][/*][*][p]Windowed mode should relinquish mouse capture when alt tabbing,[/p][/*][*][p]Windowed mode should no longer launch borderless,[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX to Corrupt Bloodfang's attacks,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where enemy projectiles could have vertical motion and pass overhead,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Koenig base ability, healing on blocks, was not triggering,[/p][/*][*][p]Altered the motion and speed of pick ups to improve behavior when Range & Movement speed are buffed[/p][/*][/list][p]V 0.8.1.19 [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game would get stuck paused with only the pause background visible[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Your Friend,
Marvin Wizard[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Week 1
notes.content:
[p]I can't post demo patch notes directly to the demo page, so will periodically update here with changes. I keep things live and up to date on [url="https://discord.gg/aRpTSz5dDM"]Discord [/url]if you're looking for more frequent updates.

V 0.8.1.12 [/p][list][*][p]Added the gem unlock for maxing out devotion to Divinity,[/p][/*][*][p]Altered the fragmentation resonance to also split force weapons attacks into multiple projectiles,[/p][/*][*][p]Minor buff to force weapon damage,[/p][/*][*][p]After wave 10 enemies have a chance to drop a new item that attracts crystals,[/p][/*][*][p]Actually reduced the final bosses HP[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted wave reward schedule to have a more consistent pace of macro level build decisions,[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon choices now indicate what their potency effect is[/p][/*][/list][p]V 0.8.1.14 - Small Fix [/p][list][*][p]Mouse captured during windowed gameplay to prevent clicking outside of the game[/p][/*][/list][p]V 0.8.1.15 - Localization Correction [/p][list][*][p]Fixed the localization descriptions for the 4 color resonance unlocks[/p][/*][/list][p]V 0.8.1.16 [/p][list][*][p]Fixed a big where the player could become invincible,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where collection range was not resetting between runs[/p][/*][/list][p]V 0.8.1.17[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where burn continued to tick on invisible felled enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Audio refactor 😱, balanced audio across the spectrum and made adjustments to prevent audio clipping[/p][/*][*][p]Added enemy hit confirmation SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Added player taking damage SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Added an animation & SFX for picking up specials/health/crystal magnets[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted enemy projectiles to (hopefully) improve visibility[/p][/*][/list][p]
Huge thanks to everyone who's played and provided feedback, it really helps to drive things forward and refine the experience.

Your friend,
Marvin Wizard[/p]
